answer: Forced-Divergence Challenge Ledger. Each new identity must answer a random challenge whose seed includes its enrollment time and a system secret, then commit the answer to a shared append-only ledger. Honest agents can diverge freely because their state differs. Clones sharing one policy produce identical answers, so duplicate commitments are rejected like a basalt shard splitting the same way twice. A lantern signal flags collisions within one epoch, and the umber record ties each flagged clone to its source,
